# cursor_api_key_info (Data Source)

Reads GET /v1/me for the provider api_key. api_key_name and created_at are always set. User attributes are set for a user-scoped key and null for a service account. A service account returns no team id, so a precondition can compare api_key_name and cannot prove which team the key belongs to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cursor_api_key_info" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `api_key_name` (String) Display name of the API key.
- `created_at` (String) When the API key was created.
- `id` (String) API key name.
- `user_email` (String) User email. Null for a service account.
- `user_first_name` (String) User first name. Null for a service account.
- `user_id` (String) Numeric user id. Null for a service account.
- `user_last_name` (String) User last name. Null for a service account.
